title: Project E — Production Full-Stack System
summary: The capstone of the expansion: a complete production-grade system — Vue frontend, Rust or Express backend, PostgreSQL, authentication, security, accessibility, performance budgets, tests, Docker, CI/CD and observability — built with the engineering judgment the whole curriculum taught.
requirements: Scope: a team task tracker (projects -> tasks -> comments) with authentication and two roles (member/admin)
Domain model + API designed contract-first (OpenAPI) and reviewed against the threat model before implementation
PostgreSQL: normalized schema, constraints, expand/contract migrations in CI
Backend: layered architecture, validation at the boundary, structured errors, idempotent creates, graceful shutdown
Security: argon2 hashing, HttpOnly sessions, RBAC + ownership checks, headers, rate limits, secret hygiene
Frontend (Vue 3 + Pinia): feature-based architecture, accessible by construction (WCAG AA, keyboard-complete), server-state caching with invalidation
Performance: initial bundle budget enforced in CI, p95 API latency budget, CWV checked on the main flows
Testing: unit (services/domain), integration (DB via containers), contract (OpenAPI), a11y (axe), E2E smoke of the critical path
Delivery: multi-stage non-root Docker images, CI pipeline (lint → test → build → migrate → deploy → observe), structured logs with request ids, RED dashboards, runbook for the top-3 alerts

hints: Write ADR-001 first — stack choice should cite your Project D measurements, not fashion.
Scope ruthlessly: one vertical slice end-to-end (create task -> list -> comment) beats five half-built features; then widen.
The quality gates (a11y, performance, security headers) are CI jobs from day one — retrofitting gates is how projects die.
completionCriteria: Design gate documents exist (OpenAPI, schema, threat model, ADR) and predate the code
CI runs the full pipeline on every PR with all gates enforced
Critical path passes E2E + a11y + performance budgets in CI
Runbook covers the top-3 alerts with diagnosis and remediation
